_about: Swing5 footwork skeletons, written by hand in the web editor (python RunWeb.py). cm; local frame per element: the leader's left foot at (0,0), heading 0 = +y, clockwise positive. Only the editor writes this file.

side.desc: Side by side, both facing the same way, follower on the leader's right (the user's basic position). His right shoe and her left shoe 4 cm apart: 34 cm between body centres (user 2026-10-19; it was 45, an agent guess).

facing.desc: Facing each other, open hold, leader's left hand holding the follower's right. 31 cm between body centres: a 5 cm gap between the toes of the facing shoes (user 2026-10-19; it was 70, user Q5).

reversed_side.desc: Side by side, follower on the leader's LEFT, his left arm around her back (user Q1). Her right shoe 4 cm from his left.
